'''Abu Banu''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] who served aboard the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]].

==Biography==
Banu was reputably one of the best [[Brain/Legends|brain]] surgeons in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] and, as the battle station's only qualified [[Wikipedia:neurosurgery|neurosurgeon]], he was one of few non-[[Human/Legends|Human]] beings in a position of authority onboard. Banu was the head of the surgical team that conducted the operation to save [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Natasi Daala]]'s life after she was injured in the [[attack on the first Death Star]]. After the operation, [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]] was not thrilled with the result, but he refrained from punishing Banu.<ref name="Death Star" />
